correction_reason: Pre-use recursive audit found that v1 did not explicitly attest the product-context blindness required by frozen R6 timing. R1-R5 are blind and R6 reveals Kymaean/MOT-01 product context only after those judgments are locked. No primary record or reviewer exposure occurred under v1, so this correction changes only review-integrity mechanics and no family, score, threshold, pass rule or termination law.

claim_boundary.purpose: Mechanical collection format and sequencing for the already-frozen MOT-01 blinded-review law. It does not add or alter a score, threshold, family, control, timing vector, candidate pass rule or termination rule.

reviewer_must_not_receive_before_pre_rev: family names attached to anonymous IDs
Kymaean/MOT-01 product purpose or shared-brand motion hypothesis
specific product/Stage semantics being tested in R6

review_population.current_design_sol_eligibility: INELIGIBLE_FOR_PRIMARY_BLIND_RECORD_IN_THIS RUN because the construction/preflight process inspected implementation-level anonymous-to-mechanism mapping.
review_population.current_director_session_eligibility: INELIGIBLE_FOR_PRIMARY_BLIND_RECORD_IN_THIS RUN because the current Director session has already received the MOT-01 product/shared-brand context before R1-R5 could be locked.
review_population.current_run_requirement: Use three genuinely blind reviewers who have not seen the anonymous mapping or MOT-01/Kymaean product context before R1-R5 lock. At least one of the three must be an independent human visual reviewer outside the construction process; the other two may be independent humans or genuinely blind independent evaluators.

review_sequence.rule: Reviewer receives only the frozen reviewer surface plus harness bytes and pre-reveal neutral instructions. Do not identify Kymaean, Ensemble, shared-brand research, MOT-01 purpose, product semantics, family names, source IDs or mapping. The literal MOT-01 label already present in the frozen reviewer title is treated only as an opaque experiment identifier and must not be explained. Replay is explicit and may be used as needed.

At WIDE and REFLOW_320 independently, pair every anonymous WEB specimen to exactly one anonymous APP specimen by perceived motion mechanism. Each WEB and APP ID must be used exactly once at its viewport. This supplies frozen R1 control-calibration pairing evidence and R2 candidate-pairing evidence after later unblinding.

Without source/family/product disclosure, match the six WIDE WEB-APP pairs to the six REFLOW_320 WEB-APP pairs by perceived same mechanism and assign reviewer-local group labels G1 through G6. This is record addressing only and adds no pass criterion or score.

For each reviewer-local G1-G6 group, lock one forced genericity category, one R4 distinctiveness score and one R5 cross-surface-restraint score after considering its four anonymous specimens. Product identity/purpose remains undisclosed.
All three primary reviewers' R1-R5 pre-reveal records must be durably frozen before any primary reviewer receives the R6 product-context reveal.

After all three pre-reveal locks, reveal only that Kymaean/MOT-01 is testing a shared-brand motion mechanism across expressive WEB and restrained APP-like contexts and ask whether each anonymous group falsely implies completion, loading, success/failure, causal commit, Character acting, Stage transition or another specific product semantic absent from the neutral fixture. Do not reveal family/source IDs or the blinding key.
Each reviewer freezes an R6 addendum referencing the SHA-256 of that reviewer's immutable pre-reveal record. The addendum cannot alter pairings, groups, R3 category, R4 score or R5 score.

Q-DESIGN-10 may close only when three logical primary records each have immutable pre-reveal and post-reveal components with valid reviewer provenance and no premature family unblinding. Aggregation/control calibration/family pass-fail remains a separate successor gate.

R5_CROSS_SURFACE_RESTRAINT.0: APP and WEB become unrelated or one context is unusably theatrical/generic
R5_CROSS_SURFACE_RESTRAINT.1: shared mechanism survives with some ambiguity
R5_CROSS_SURFACE_RESTRAINT.2: same mechanism remains clearly legible while APP is materially restrained relative to WEB

reviewer_provenance.reviewer_label: non-identifying stable label such as Independent-Human-01 or Independent-Evaluator-01

pairing.WIDE: array of exactly six {web_id, app_id} entries forming a bijection over anonymous_universe.WIDE
pairing.REFLOW_320: array of exactly six {web_id, app_id} entries forming a bijection over anonymous_universe.REFLOW_320

pre_reveal_record_schema.cross_width_groups: array of exactly six entries {group_id:G1..G6, wide:{web_id,app_id}, reflow_320:{web_id,app_id}}. Every declared pair must exist in pairing and every viewport-level pair is used once across G1-G6.
pre_reveal_record_schema.group_judgments: object keyed G1..G6; each value requires genericity from forced R3 values, distinctiveness integer 0..2, cross_surface_restraint integer 0..2, and optional concise blind_note.
pre_reveal_record_schema.locked_at: ISO-8601 timestamp supplied when record is frozen

post_reveal_addendum_schema.pre_reveal_sha256: SHA-256 of immutable pre-reveal JSON bytes

context_reveal_attestation.revealed_context_only: Kymaean/MOT-01 shared-brand motion identity question; no anonymous-to-family mapping

post_reveal_addendum_schema.false_semantics: object keyed G1..G6; each value requires flag boolean, categories array drawn from forced R6 categories, and optional concise note. categories must be empty when flag=false and non-empty when flag=true.
post_reveal_addendum_schema.locked_at: ISO-8601 timestamp supplied when addendum is frozen

mechanical_validation_before_acceptance: Reviewer packet hashes equal the frozen c399 packet hashes.
Record ID is unique among PR-01..PR-03 and each record is from a distinct reviewer.
Current-run reviewer has not seen product context/MOT-01 purpose, mapping, family/source IDs or another primary judgment before pre-reveal lock.
Across three records, at least one reviewer is an independent human visual reviewer outside construction; no ineligible current Design Sol or current Director-session record is accepted.
WIDE and REFLOW_320 pairings are exact six-pair bijections over the frozen anonymous sets.
G1-G6 cross-width groups reference only declared pairs and cover all pairs exactly once.
Every G1-G6 has exactly one forced R3 category and integer R4/R5 values in 0..2.
All six pre-reveal blindness attestations are true.
No R6 reveal occurs until all three pre-reveal records are durably frozen.
Post-reveal addendum references the exact immutable pre-reveal SHA-256 and does not replace it.
R6 false-semantics flags/categories obey the declared shape.
No record contains source family IDs, source specimen IDs, blinding-key content, aggregate candidate scores or family pass/fail conclusions before the successor unblinding gate.

successor_boundary.after_three_primary_records: A separate queue gate may unblind the frozen records, test CNEG/CPOS calibration, map reviewer-local groups to frozen source families, aggregate R2-R6 under the original conjunctive law, and apply the original termination/outcome rules.
